description: Standardized bilingual glossary of Balinese cultural, customary, administrative, and statutory terms for Pramana corpus translations.

terms.Utama Mandala: Utama Mandala (innermost sacred courtyard of a temple)
terms.Madya Mandala: Madya Mandala (middle courtyard of a temple)
terms.Nista Mandala: Nista Mandala (outer courtyard of a temple)
terms.Padmasana: Padmasana (supreme shrine / throne of Sang Hyang Widhi Wasa)
terms.Pelinggih: Pelinggih (sacred shrine or seat of deity)
terms.Tri Hita Karana: Tri Hita Karana (philosophy of harmony between God, people, and nature)
terms.Sad Kerthi: Sad Kerthi (six aspects of cosmic purification)
terms.Nyepi: Nyepi (Day of Silence / Balinese Saka New Year)
terms.Catur Brata Penyepian: Catur Brata Penyepian (the four sacred prohibitions observed during Nyepi)
terms.Amati Geni: Amati Geni (prohibition against lighting fire or lights)
terms.Amati Karya: Amati Karya (prohibition against physical work or labor)
terms.Amati Lelanguan: Amati Lelanguan (prohibition against entertainment or leisure)
